}}'''Jillien''' is an Ebou Dari [[goldsmith]] who resided at the [[kin|Kin's]] farm.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jillien}}

==Appearance==
Jillien is a plump woman.{{ref/book|8|20}}

==Activities==
Jillien is among the women of the Kin who flee the [[Farm]] because of the [[Seanchan]] invasion of [[Altara]]. She is one of the ten slowest to get ready to leave and is made to do dishes that night by [[Alise Tenjile]].{{ref/book|8|20}} She accompanies [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Aviendha]] and the rest of the Kin to [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|8|28}}
